description: Returns a comprehensive Product Requirements Document with problem statement, user personas, features, success metrics, and scope

result.problem_statement: Small business owners and finance managers often spend excessive time on manual expense tracking, receipt collection, and reconciliation. This process is error-prone, inefficient, and detracts from higher-value business activities. An AI-powered expense management platform can automate data entry and receipt management, enabling SMBs to save time, reduce errors, and improve financial insights.

user_personas.name: Sarah, Small Business Owner
user_personas.description: Owns a local retail store with 10 employees. Manages all business finances herself.
pain_points: Manually tracking receipts and paper invoices
Lack of real-time visibility into spending
goals: Stay on top of cash flow
Easily comply with tax and audit requirements

user_personas.name: James, Finance Manager
user_personas.description: Handles finances for a 25-person marketing agency. Oversees team expense submissions and reimbursement.
goals: Automate receipt capture and expense categorization

features.name: AI Receipt Capture
features.description: Users snap photos or upload receipts; AI extracts relevant details and categorizes expenses automatically.
features.user_value: Eliminates manual data entry and reduces errors in expense tracking.

features.name: Automated Expense Categorization
features.description: AI intelligently assigns expenses to the correct categories based on business rules and transaction history.
features.user_value: Saves time and ensures consistency for accounting and reporting.

features.name: Dashboard & Real-time Reporting
features.description: Interactive dashboard providing spend analytics, trends, and compliance alerts.
features.user_value: Gives users instant feedback and helps identify cost-saving opportunities.

features.name: Integration with Accounting Software
features.description: Connects seamlessly with popular accounting tools (e.g., QuickBooks, Xero) for automatic data sync.
features.user_value: Reduces duplication of work and helps maintain a single source of truth.

features.name: Multi-user Role Management
features.description: Admins can set permissions, approve expenses, and manage employee access.
features.user_value: Ensures control and security as businesses grow their teams.

success_metrics.target: At least 70% less time spent on data entry per month
success_metrics.measurement_method: User time-tracking logs and survey responses
Internal QA audits and user feedback

success_metrics.target: 70% of signed-up users submit expenses monthly

in_scope: AI-based receipt and invoice data extraction
Dashboard with analytics and compliance alerts
Integrations with popular SMB accounting software
out_of_scope: Tax filing or direct tax payment features

result.summary: This PRD outlines an AI-powered expense management platform tailored for small businesses and finance managers who seek to automate receipt capture, expense categorization, and reporting. By streamlining these processes via AI and seamless integrations, the platform aims to save time, increase accuracy, and deliver actionable insights while remaining focused on SMB needs without extending into payroll or large enterprise solutions.
